yt_title: The 1 in 635 Billion Card Hand Almost Nobody Gets
yt_description:
What are the odds of being dealt all 13 spades in a bridge hand? 1 in 635,013,559,600, about 2,000 times rarer than winning the Powerball, so if you dealt one hand every second you'd wait about 20,000 years. We rank 8 card odds from easy to impossible: drawing a heart (1 in 4), an ace (1 in 13), blackjack in your first two cards (1 in 21), pocket aces (1 in 221), four of a kind (1 in 4,165) and a straight flush (1 in 72,193).

Which of these have you actually been dealt? Comment below and subscribe for new odds videos every day.
